payload.title: Preserve provider-returned confidence across decision adapters
payload.description: Original evaluation provenance requires returned confidence as well as full probabilities. Add optional finite nonboolean confidence in [0,1] to the provider-neutral DecisionResult without positional API drift; preserve only explicit provider confidence in Jev, compatible System One/Kev, and Laya adapters. Never synthesize it from maximum probability or retain arbitrary raw payloads. Adjacent fake-client specs must prove exact retention, missing-as-None, malformed rejection, and no network/keys.
